clips.title: The story
paras: Cry of the Thunderhawk is the culmination of Jorn Skyseer's hunting trials in the southern Barrens. Entrusted by the elders at Camp Taurajo, a hunter must seek out a winged serpent soaring through the scrublands and bring back its wings to prove their mastery over the savanna's fiercest beasts.

After proving their mettle against prowling plainstriders, prowlers, and agitated thunder lizards, hunters in the Barrens are directed toward their ultimate challenge by Jorn Skyseer. The thunderhawk is considered one of the most fierce aerial predators inhabiting the scrublands surrounding Camp Taurajo. Slaying one requires patience, sharp aim, and an awareness of the sky that few landbound predators possess.

Returning with the thunderhawk's wings marks the end of a novice's tutelage under Camp Taurajo's watchful eyes. For the tauren, hunting is not mere slaughter but an ongoing spiritual walk in harmony with the Earthmother and the natural hierarchy of the wild. Besting such a proud creature shows that the hunter acts with strength, courage, and honor—virtues required before stepping out into harsher wildernesses beyond the central plains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The thunderhawk, friend, is a fierce beast. It is time for you to face them. You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.
Do this, and your time with me will near its end.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud. You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.
But your path, friend, continues. In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.
Now, it is time to move on.
